result.stdout:
Usage: seq-mcp <command> [<args>] [--option value]

  seq-mcp query    <sql>
      Run a Seq SQL query; compact tabular results (group by / aggregates).
        --from     ISO-8601 UTC window start (default: 24h ago)
        --to       ISO-8601 UTC window end (default: now)
        --signal   Saved signal id to scope to (from `signals`)
  seq-mcp errors   
      Most recent Error/Fatal events (up to 20), newest first.
        --minutes  Look-back window in minutes (default: 30)
  seq-mcp search   <filter>
      Search events by a Seq filter expression, newest first.
        --count    Max events to return (default: 30)
        --signal   Saved signal id to scope to (from `signals`)
  seq-mcp event    <id>
      Full detail for a single event by its id.
  seq-mcp signals  
      List saved signals as Id · Title.
        --filter   Case-insensitive title substring
  seq-mcp alerts   
      List configured alerts as Id · Title (with a [disabled] marker).
        --filter   Case-insensitive title substring
  seq-mcp alert    <id>
      Full detail for a single alert by its id.
  seq-mcp alert-state 
      Alerts currently firing (Status · Occurrences · Last check).

  --env <name>           target a configured Seq environment (default: the configured default)
  seq-mcp commands       full command surface as JSON (for tools/agents)
  seq-mcp --stdio        run as an MCP server over stdio
  seq-mcp --http         run as an MCP server over HTTP
